description: Gamified health, habit, productivity, and life-management Progressive Web App (Meat Suit Pilot)
author: l4leather@gmail.com
styling: Tailwind CSS v4 + Motion v12 + Lucide React

routes.purpose: Command center, XP radar/levels, daily quests, quick habit toggles, and Strava summary
10-parameter vital stats rating (1-5 sliders), mood observation, and check-in logging
Long-term Projects, intermediate Missions, and daily executable Quests hierarchy
Daily habit tracking, completion history, and streak calculations
Daily weight, sleep/wake times, supplements/teas, meals, AI calorie estimation, and Strava workout sync
Unified agenda combining Google Calendar events, Google Tasks, and daily local Quests
Financial management, account balances (TSB, Nationwide, Halifax, Virgin, Cash), bills, expenses, and wishlist
Historical trend charts, 30-day stats aggregation, and weekly reflection logs
Check-in time schedules, Strava OAuth connection, weight goals, and data management

apiEndpoints.purpose: AI estimation of meal calories and nutritionist notes
Returns Strava configuration status, callback domain, and redirect URI
Generates Strava OAuth authorize URL with dynamic redirect_uri
Handles OAuth code exchange with Strava and stores tokens in Firestore
Fetches recent athlete activities from Strava API v3 with automatic token refresh
Proxies aggregated check-in and habit data to external business dashboard

collections.name: users/{userId}
collections.description: User gamification profile, levels, total XP, streaks, and check-in times

collections.name: users/{userId}/healthLogs/{dateStr}
collections.description: Daily health metrics, sleep, wake time, weight, supplements, teas, meals, and exercises

collections.name: users/{userId}/projects/{projectId}
collections.description: High-level long term goal projects with Notion links

collections.name: users/{userId}/quests/{questId}
collections.description: Daily actionable tasks associated with missions or projects

collections.name: users/{userId}/habits/{habitId}
collections.description: Daily habit tracking definitions and completion histories

collections.name: users/{userId}/bills/{billId}
collections.description: Monthly recurring bills and due dates

collections.name: users/{userId}/wishlist/{wishlistId}
collections.description: Saved future purchases and target costs

collections.name: users/{userId}/settings/preferences
collections.description: User notification toggles, check-in time schedules, and weight goals

collections.name: users/{userId}/stravaTokens/main
collections.description: Encrypted/stored OAuth tokens and refresh credentials for Strava

models.task: Meal calorie estimation and nutritionist breakdown notes

integrations.name: Cloud Firestore
integrations.status: active (to be migrated to Supabase Postgres)

migrationTarget.hosting: Cloudflare Pages (Client SPA) + Cloudflare Functions / Workers (API routes)
migrationTarget.database: Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS)
migrationTarget.auth: Supabase Auth (Google Provider with Calendar/Tasks scopes)
migrationTarget.ai: Direct Google Gemini API (@google/genai SDK or REST API with custom GEMINI_API_KEY)
